title: KickTodo specialist handoff task
description: The bounded task KickBot hands to a convened specialist skill (ADR 0442 P5). Advisory only: the specialist reasons over the participant's state and PROPOSES; it never commits domain state.

goal.description: What KickBot needs the specialist to advise on (e.g. 'draft a 5-day plan', 'flag safety concerns', 'verify claimed progress').

context.description: Optional grounding text (e.g. the participant's current Today/Progress summary).
